style_prompts.prompt_en: [PROJECT] Seedance 2.0. Duration: 8 seconds. Aspect ratio: 16:9. One controlled production shot, not a full scene. Use @CharacterName, @LocationName, and @PropName as locked Elements; preserve identity, wardrobe, proportions, prop geometry, layout, texture, and palette. Make it feel built by a DOP, gaffer, key grip, operator, and colorist. [BLOCKING / SHOT DESIGN] Compose as a medium-wide frame that slowly resolves into a tense medium close-up through foreground rain streaks. @CharacterName steps from shadow into leaking marquee light, notices @PropName, reaches toward it, then stops before touching it. The action has a beginning, middle, and end, with no new characters, no time jump, and no scene change. Keep motivated eyelines, screen direction, geography, and coverage. Let micro-behavior carry emotion: breath, hesitation, eye flick, hand tension, weight shift, or pause. [CAMERA] Camera package: large-format digital cinema body, open gate capture, high dynamic range, log image, 4K/6K delivery, protected highlights. Mount and movement: low dolly push on short track with tiny human corrections, not a perfect robotic move. Operator language: patient, observant, slightly predatory, discovering evidence a half-second before the character. Camera height: chest height, slightly below eye line, with a subtle low-angle power imbalance. Preserve headroom, negative space, foreground occlusion, parallax, and depth. Movement must obey physical limits: no floating camera, teleport, unmotivated orbit, or digital zoom. If it moves, it should read as dolly, slider, Steadicam, gimbal, handheld shoulder, suction mount, crane, or fluid-head sticks. [OPTICS / FOCUS] Lens language: 35mm anamorphic prime, mild barrel distortion, oval bokeh, close-focus capability, soft edges, clean center sharpness. Aperture: T2.8. Filtration: 1/8 Black Pro-Mist, gentle halation around signs, restrained bloom. Focus: slow rack from rain beads to the eyes, then to the prop. Keep eyes, hands, mouth, and hero prop stable. Use focal length emotionally: wide lenses reveal space and speed; normal lenses feel observational; long lenses compress and isolate. Include natural breathing, falloff, bokeh, and flare; avoid phone-like sharpening unless surveillance texture is requested. [LIGHTING / GAFFER PLAN] Key: hard motivated practical from a broken sign above and behind camera-left, cooled by rain haze. Fill: very low ambient bounce from wet pavement, with black solids camera-side to deepen cheek shadows. Backlight/rim/kicker: narrow amber kicker from a shop window and a cool rim over shoulders and hair. Practicals: neon signage, sodium streetlamp spill, distant police-light flicker, puddle reflections. Modifiers and grip: flags to cut spill, 4x4 floppy negative fill, rain bars, wet-down street, thin haze. Contrast: 4:1 to 8:1. Quality: hard-edged practical light softened only by rain and atmosphere. Light needs direction, falloff, separation, and motivation. Shape it with flags, cutters, solids, diffusion, bounce, nets, haze, atmosphere, or negative fill. Do not make every face evenly lit; keep eye detail unless silhouette is requested. [COLOR / TEXTURE / CONSTRAINTS] Palette: cyan-blue shadows, amber practicals, dirty greens, muted reds, wet black asphalt, pale skin highlights. Exposure and texture: slightly underexposed shadows, protected highlights, fine grain, natural lens flare, imperfect exposure. Post feel: low-contrast film print with lifted blacks, subtle halation, no crushed detail. Avoid plastic skin, beauty retouching, AI-shiny surfaces, excessive HDR, over-sharpening, fake text, random logos, warped architecture, melting props, duplicate faces, extra fingers, and inconsistent costumes. Audio: rain on metal, distant traffic hiss, buzzing neon transformer, one soft breath. Final result: professional neo-noir thriller footage, motivated, plausible, and emotionally precise.
